plugins.name: lender-policy
plugins.description: Your Quickli policy library, searchable in plain English. Builds a local copy from YOUR OWN Quickli login and keeps it on your machine — this plugin ships no policy content. Reads Quickli in your browser, writes only to ~/.claude/lender-policy. Needs a paid Quickli subscription.

plugins.name: file-audit
plugins.description: Read-only compliance audit of one client's document folder: fraud detection (PDF tamper forensics, payslip arithmetic, cross-document identity checks) plus the LM minimum supporting documents checklist. READ-ONLY — never writes, renames or deletes in a client folder, never sends anything anywhere, never records a TFN or CRN. Reports go to your own output folder. Runs entirely on your machine.
